description: CRM platform with APIs for accessing and modifying Salesforce data and resources.
access_model: self-serve development org; org/client-app configuration required
api_surface: REST API plus other Salesforce APIs
main_blocker: OAuth/client-app setup and organization-level authorization; Salesforce says new connected-app creation is restricted from Spring '26 and recommends external client apps.
evidence_notes: Salesforce documents OAuth 2.0 for REST API authorization.
Salesforce documents a free Developer Edition for testing/development and external client app setup.
MCP was not established from the official sources checked in this pilot.

description: Team communication platform with a Web API, events, messaging and app integrations.
access_model: self-serve app creation/install for standard development; some capabilities are plan/admin restricted
api_surface: Web API, Events API, webhooks and app platform
main_blocker: Certain admin/enterprise capabilities require higher plans or administrator-level permissions.
evidence_notes: Slack says new apps can be created and installed for testing/development and uses app access tokens/OAuth.
Slack documents OAuth-based installation and permission scopes.
Some admin methods are Enterprise-plan and admin/owner restricted.

description: Commerce platform with APIs for merchant, storefront and customer-account data and operations.
access_model: developer/self-serve for app development, but merchant authorization and API scopes are required; some APIs may require approval or specific plans
api_surface: GraphQL Admin API, Storefront API, Customer Account API, Partner API and related APIs
main_blocker: Merchant authorization/scopes and API-specific approval or plan requirements for some surfaces.
evidence_notes: Shopify documents OAuth/token flows and access scopes across its APIs.
Shopify notes that some APIs can require approval or a specific Shopify plan.
MCP was not established from the official sources checked in this pilot.

description: Developer collaboration platform with a broad REST API for repositories, issues, users, organizations and more.
access_model: self-serve; credentials can be created by developers, with permissions varying by credential type and resource
api_surface: broad versioned REST API with OpenAPI description; also broader GitHub platform APIs
main_blocker: Permissions and organization policies can restrict particular resources/actions.
evidence_notes: GitHub documents a versioned REST API and OpenAPI description.
GitHub documents personal access tokens, GitHub Apps and OAuth tokens as API authentication options.
Permissions and organization policies constrain what a credential can access.

description: Payments and financial infrastructure platform with APIs for payments, customers, subscriptions, billing and connected accounts.
access_model: self-serve test-mode API access after account setup; live capabilities can depend on account/business requirements
api_surface: broad REST API covering payments, customers, subscriptions, billing, disputes, events and more
main_blocker: Live financial operations depend on account state and Stripe requirements; credential security is critical.
evidence_notes: Stripe documents API-key authentication and test/live keys.
Stripe's API reference exposes many resource families including PaymentIntents, Customers, Subscriptions, Checkout and Events.
The API docs provide sample test keys for examples.
